value.rationale: The cross-polytope boundary is a canonical signed-permutation-symmetric polyhedral surface. The exact norm controls worst-case L-infinity amplification in affine least-squares approximation, and the positivity defect quantifies how far a bounded nonnegative input can be projected below zero. Its linear growth, d/2+O(1), is a meaningful dimension-dependent stability boundary rather than a routine numerical example.
